picture-format.adjust.remove-background.note: U:quill/shapes: Remove Background (picture.removeBackground): the area connected to the picture's edge that is close to its corner colour becomes transparent; there is no marking tool (wordcraft has none).

picture-format.adjust.icon-color.note: U:quill/shapes: Icon Color (picture.iconColor): one colour everywhere in the picture with its transparency kept, for icons and other one-colour line art.

picture-format.adjust.artistic-effects.note: U:quill/shapes: the five effects wordcraft draws (blur, sharpen, invert, posterize, pixelate), one at a time; a second one replaces the first, and None takes it off.

picture-format.adjust.compress-pictures.note: U:quill/shapes: Compress Pictures (picture.compress): the longer side is at most 1600 pixels (upstream resamples with Lanczos, here a box filter); Word's options dialog (resolution, delete cropped areas) is not upstream.

picture-format.adjust.change-picture.fro.note: U:quill/shapes: From Stock Images needs Microsoft's online stock library; hidden.
U:quill/shapes: From Online Sources needs Bing image search; hidden.

picture-format.adjust.reset-picture.rese.note: U:quill/shapes: Reset Picture & Size (not in wordcraft; follows Word): the original bitmap, no crop, and the size of what is left of the original.

picture-format.picture-styles.styles.note: U:quill/shapes: wordcraft's five styles (Simple Frame, Thick Frame, Rounded, Soft Edge, Shadow), each drawn on a sample picture; the picture's bitmap is redrawn, and a second style replaces the first.

picture-format.picture-styles.picture-bo.note: U:quill/shapes: Picture Border (picture.border): a frame of 2, 4 or 8 pixels (or No Outline) in the chosen colour, keeping the style. Weight and Dashes are Word's and not upstream; hidden.

picture-format.picture-styles.picture-la.note: U:quill/shapes: Picture Layout converts to SmartArt; wordcraft has no engine; hidden.

picture-format.size.crop.note: U:quill/shapes: Crop opens the Format Picture pane on its Crop offsets (left, top, right, bottom, in percent; wordcraft crops with on-page handles, which this page view does not draw yet); Aspect Ratio crops the sides evenly to that shape (not in wordcraft; follows Word). Crop to Shape, Fill and Fit are U:quill/rest (not checked against upstream).

items.label: Crop to Shape
items.note: U:quill/rest: Crop to Shape: what lies outside the chosen closed shape becomes transparent in the picture's bitmap; Reset Picture brings it back. Not checked against upstream (follows Word, which keeps the shape as the picture's geometry).

items.label: Fill
items.note: U:quill/rest: Fill: the picture fills its frame, the sides that do not fit cropped evenly. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

items.label: Fit
items.note: U:quill/rest: Fit: the whole picture shown, uncropped, in the largest frame of its own shape inside the old one. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

picture-format.size.crop-l-t-r-b.note: U:quill/shapes: the four crop offsets are in the Format Picture pane (Crop), where each has its own field; hidden here.

picture-format.size.width.note: U:quill/shapes: Width in points; the height follows so the proportions stay.

shape-format.size.width.note: U:quill/shapes: Width in points of the shape; the height stays.

shape-format.insert-shapes.shapes.note: U:quill/shapes: the same shapes as Insert › Shapes, drawn from their geometry; the new shape is selected, so Shape Format stays.

shape-format.insert-shapes.edit-shape.note: U:quill/shapes: Change Shape turns the selected shape into one of the kinds the page view draws. Edit Points turns the shape into a freeform that keeps its curves and edits it with PowerPoint path engine (core/prism/lib/points.mjs); wordcraft has no Edit Points, not checked against upstream. Reroute Connectors is shape.rerouteConnectors (U:quill/rest).

chart-format.current-selection.element.note: U:quill/chart-format: the chart elements (Chart Area, Chart Title, Legend, a series by name) Format Selection acts on; type a series name for a series past the third. In Word, wordcraft has no Chart Format: not checked against upstream.

chart-format.current-selection.format-se.note: U:quill/chart-format: opens the Format pane on the chosen element: Fill & Line for the chart area (fill, border) and a series (colour), the title text, the legend position. Not checked against upstream.

chart-format.shape-styles.shape-styles.note: U:quill/chart-format: the 42 Shape Styles of Shape Format; the chart area takes the fill and border of the style (saved as the chart space shape properties); the shadow of a style is not drawn on a chart. Not checked against upstream.

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.no-.note: U:quill/shapes: the colour palette has its own No Color; this one is the same entry, hidden.

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.mor.note: U:quill/shapes: the colour palette has its own More Colors…; this one is the same entry, hidden.

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.gra.note: U:quill/shapes: the shape's colour, solid (a gradient's middle stop).

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.gra.label: Light Variations
shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.gra.note: U:quill/shapes: the 13 light variations of the shape's colour (shape_fill.rs variations), in Word's order.

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.gra.label: Dark Variations
shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.gra.note: U:quill/shapes: the 13 dark variations of the shape's colour.

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-outline.note: U:quill/shapes: colour and weight; a weight keeps the current colour. Sketched, Dashes and Arrows have no engine upstream; hidden.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors palette

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-styles.note: U:quill/shapes: the 42 Shape Styles (6 rows × Dark 1 and Accent 1–6) in the theme colours, from deckcraft quick_style_for: fill, outline and effect of the selected shapes. Not in wordcraft.

shape-format.wordart-styles.styles.note: U:quill/shapes: wordcraft's eight WordArt styles in the theme colours, each drawn with its fill, outline, shadow and glow.

shape-format.wordart-styles.text-fill.note: U:quill/shapes: Text Fill (wordArt.textFill): automatic (the text's colour), no fill (hollow), a colour or a two-colour gradient, on the whole text of the shape.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors palette

shape-format.wordart-styles.text-outline.note: U:quill/shapes: Text Outline (wordArt.textOutline): automatic, none, a colour and a weight (a weight keeps the colour).

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors palette

shape-format.wordart-styles.text-effects.note: U:quill/shapes: Transform bends the shape's text along one of the twelve warps wordcraft draws (the others it keeps when it reads a file). Shadow, Glow and Reflection are Home › Font's format.textEffects; Bevel and 3-D Rotation have no engine upstream; hidden.

shape-format.text.text-direction.note: U:quill/shapes: Text Direction (shape.textDirection): horizontal, rotated 90° or 270°, or stacked, for the selected text box or the one the caret is in.

shape-format.text.create-link.note: U:quill/shapes: Create Link continues the selected text box in the next empty, unlinked text box of the document; Break Link ends it (shape.breakLink).

home.font.text-effects-and-typography.note: U:quill/shapes: Text Effects (format.textEffects): WordArt styles, text fill, outline, shadow, glow and reflection on the selected text, drawn by the page view and saved as w14 text effects. Ligatures and Stylistic Sets have no engine (wordcraft keeps them as they are read); hidden.

insert.text.wordart.note: U:quill/shapes: WordArt (insert.wordArt): a floating text box at the caret in one of wordcraft's eight styles, drawn and saved as w14 text effects.

dialog.pictureSize.title: Layout
dialog.pictureSize.note: U:quill/shapes: Word's Layout dialog (Position, Text Wrapping, Size) over arrange.layout, picture.size and arrange.rotation, in one undo step. Not offered: relative (percent) positions and sizes, Move object with text, Lock anchor, Allow overlap and Layout in table cell (no such fields in the float model), and a left and right distance apart (one for both sides); the Size tab's relative-to-original box and original-size read-out are hidden.
